change.summaryToAppend: On 9 October 2026, Lilly reported a separate prespecified exploratory TOGETHER-PsO analysis of circulating proteins and blood gene expression, presented at Fall Clinical 2026. Broader biomarker changes with concomitant treatment were sponsor-reported as early as week 12 and at week 36.
change.limitationsToAppend: The biomarker announcement is exploratory sponsor-reported conference evidence, not a new trial or independently established clinical benefit, causal mechanism, comparative recommendation or UK combination approval. Its 274 randomized participants remain separate from the registry's previously reviewed 281 actual participants. No registry lifecycle or review date is advanced from this announcement.
